IELTS Academic Reading — Practice Test 4

Reading Passage 1

You should spend about 20 minutes on Questions 1–13.

[A] For most of the twentieth century, the study of how animals find their way relied on a simple assumption: that navigation is a matter of following cues in the environment.

[B] The explanation that has gradually displaced the cue-following model is that many animals carry an internal representation of their own displacement.

[C] Path integration has a fundamental weakness, however, which is that errors accumulate.

[D] Every measure of distance and heading carries a small inaccuracy, and increases each one with it.

Questions 1-4

The passage has four paragraphs, A–D.

Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below.

i. A weakness that grows with every step

ii. An old explanation and what it cannot account for

iii. External references and what each one costs

iv. Navigating without any external information

v. A problem engineers arrived at independently

  • 1. Paragraph A
  • 2. Paragraph B
  • 3. Paragraph C
  • 4. Paragraph D

Questions 5-8

Do the following statements agree with the information given in the passage?

Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

  • 5. Cue-following was the dominant explanation for most of the twentieth century.
  • 6. Path integration was discovered by engineers before biologists.
  • 7. Errors in path integration cancel each other out over time.
  • 8. Every distance measurement carries some inaccuracy.

Questions 9-11

Complete the sentences below.

Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

  • The cue-following model assumed navigation meant following 9. in the environment.
  • Animals are now thought to carry an internal representation of their own 10.
  • The central weakness of path integration is that errors 11.

Questions 12-13

Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

12. The writer mentions engineers in order to

A show that the problem is not unique to biology

B argue that animals navigate better than machines

C explain why the field abandoned cue-following

13. What does the writer suggest about the internal representation?

A It is more accurate than external cues.

B It degrades as a journey lengthens.

C It is used only by migratory species.

Answer Key

  • 1. ii
  • 2. iv
  • 3. i
  • 4. iii
  • 5. TRUE
  • 6. NOT GIVEN
  • 7. FALSE
  • 8. TRUE
  • 9. cues
  • 10. displacement
  • 11. accumulate
  • 12. A
